name: hermytt-web
description: Browser-side TS sources for hermytt's web UI. Compiled to static/*.js, then bundled into the Rust binary via include_str! / include_bytes!.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && esbuild src-ts/chat.ts src-ts/login.ts src-ts/admin.ts --bundle --outdir=static --target=es2020 --format=iife --legal-comments=none && esbuild src-ts/terminal.ts --bundle --outdir=static --target=es2022 --format=esm --external:/vendor/* --legal-comments=none
scripts.watch: esbuild src-ts/chat.ts src-ts/login.ts src-ts/admin.ts --bundle --outdir=static --target=es2020 --format=iife --watch & esbuild src-ts/terminal.ts --bundle --outdir=static --target=es2022 --format=esm --external:/vendor/* --watch
